players.detail: Flott (chest) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice session.

players.name: Elic Ayomanor
players.detail: Ayomanor caught one of two passes for 17 yards during the Titans' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Sunday. He also added a tackle on special teams.

players.name: Austin Ekeler

players.name: Dyami Brown
players.detail: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.detail: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.detail: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.
